card.line: Shur is a desert region on the northeast edge of Egypt, where Hagar met God, Israel walked after the Red Sea, and Ishmael's family later settled.

moments.title: Hagar by the spring
moments.text: Hagar ran away from Sarai and the angel of the LORD found her by a spring on the road to Shur. He told her to go back and promised her many descendants.

moments.title: Abraham settles near Shur
moments.text: Abraham settled between Kadesh and Shur. While he stayed in Gerar, God warned King Abimelech in a dream to return Sarah to him.

moments.title: Ishmael's family settles
moments.text: After Ishmael died, his descendants settled from Havilah to Shur, near the border of Egypt.

moments.title: Israel in the Desert of Shur
moments.text: Moses led Israel from the Red Sea into the Desert of Shur. They walked three days without finding water, then came to bitter water at Marah, which the LORD made sweet.

moments.title: Saul strikes the Amalekites
moments.text: Saul struck down the Amalekites all the way from Havilah to Shur. But he and his troops spared King Agag and the best of the animals.
